items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Cooper brought me in there, see.

ctx.x: And I have some personal tapes of mine here that we just listened to where you were visiting me in 1974. And because of my deep interest in you and my love for you, I was trying to tape and find out some of the things about you then. So now I've mentioned it, and I've very disturbed and I hope that this won't happen again, that in the annals of jazz, that your name will go down in the annals of American music, a man that's so deeply associated with Duke Ellington.

And another thing. When they put that book out with all the pictures of the people in the Apollo Theater, I said, where's my picture? Why ain't my picture on there? I'm just a part -- because I was there. Ralph Cooper brought me in there, see.
